relations.subject: fts:full-text-search
relations.evidence: The _Search Service_ provides extensive capabilities for _natural-language querying_: this allows special search-constraints to be applied to text-queries.

relations.subject: fts:full-text-search
relations.evidence: The role `fts_admin` must therefore be assigned to those who intend to create indexes

relations.subject: fts:full-text-search
relations.evidence: and the role `fts_searcher` to those who intend to perform searches.

relations.subject: fts:full-text-search
relations.evidence: The search service can be accessed by [search functions in SQL++ Query](../../../server/7.2/n1ql/n1ql-language-reference/searchfun.md) (formerly N1QL).

relations.subject: fts:full-text-search
relations.evidence: Couchbase SDKs provides an API for the support of Search querying. A detailed example of performing Search queries from the SDK is provided in [Searching from the SDK](../howtos/full-text-searching-with-sdk.md).

notable_absence.finding: Several of the page's own outbound links are pinned to server/7.2 paths (e.g. 'server/7.2/fts/fts-perform-searches.md') while others in the same list use server/current - an internal version inconsistency within the page's own 'Other information-sources' bullet list, not something I could resolve without guessing which is authoritative.

cross_component_finding: This page cleanly reuses two already-promoted Server RBAC roles (role:fts-admin, role:fts-searcher) by their literal internal names ('fts_admin', 'fts_searcher'), giving a clean requiresServerRole pair split by operation (index creation vs. searching) rather than one blanket role - a precise, low-risk reuse since the role strings match the promoted concepts' own aliases exactly.
